content: 1Password differentiator is Watchtower: proactive dashboard flagging weak/reused/compromised passwords (breach DB cross-check), expiring items, missing 2FA. Also strong developer-secrets story: SSH keys/API tokens/infra secrets management via CLI/SDK so secrets never land in .env or source code, with local caching for offline/rate-limit-free access. Cross-platform, audit-ready, centralized secrets across clouds/tools.
